description: Renovate in the SDK repositories vp-<api>-sdk-<language>: switched off, on purpose.
Everything in these repositories is generated by veilplane-server's CI (see veilplane/workflows, sdk/sync.sh)
and overwritten by the next sync. A pull request here would be lost at the next push of the server.
Their dependencies are updated where they come from instead:
- the libraries the SDKs use (reqwest, Jackson, ...) come from OpenAPI Generator: Renovate updates its version
in veilplane-server (sdk/pom.xml), and the next sync regenerates every SDK with it;
- the GitHub Actions of .github/workflows/sdk.yml live in veilplane/workflows (sdk-release.yml), where
Renovate updates them for all SDK repositories at once.
